what: MainAgent 0-judge adjudication omits scope-anchor and [SCOPE-REDUCTION] voter rubric
scenario_or_breakage: The plan wires --scope-anchor-file only through dispatch-plan-voters.sh to render-voter-prompt.sh. On TALLY_ELIGIBLE_COUNT==0, tally-plan-review.sh exits main-agent-vote-required and SKILL.md tells the orchestrator to vote using the generic proportionality rubric only. A MainAgent EXONERATE (or NO) on a valid scope-cut leaves YES=0, so the proposed tally-plan-review.sh override (YES>=1 && YES>=NO) never fires — contradicting the plan edge-case that a lone advocate accepts scope cuts.
suggested_fix: Add MainAgent instructions mirroring the new render-voter-prompt scope-anchor block and [SCOPE-REDUCTION] problem-first rule (read FEATURE_FILE/issue scope; judge over-scope claim, not removal precision), or document an explicit exception if 0-judge panels are out of scope.
